description: This Java class 'TableQueryData' is a data object representing datatable query information within the Apache Fineract project. It encapsulates information about a database table and associated query parameters, providing methods to check for filters and result columns.
external_methods: Serializable (interface method), Lombok annotations do not generate explicit methods

classes.name: TableQueryData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing datatable data with properties 'table' and 'query', providing methods to check for filters and result columns.

methods.name: hasFilter
methods.description: Checks if the query has a filter applied.

methods.name: hasResultColumn
methods.description: Checks if the query has result columns specified.
